clips.title: The story
paras: Isolated Pyrewood Village lies beneath Shadowfang Keep in southern Silverpine Forest. Once part of Gilneas, the settlement was stranded outside the Greymane Wall, and Arugal's curse now haunts its living residents.

Pyrewood was once a prosperous Gilnean settlement. After the Second War, King Genn Greymane sealed Gilneas behind the massive Greymane Wall, leaving Pyrewood on the wrong side. Cut off from their homeland, the townsfolk were entirely defenseless as the Scourge crossed Lordaeron during the Third War. They survived the first wave of undead, but their nightmare began when the mage Arugal took refuge in the fortress above.
